THE ITEM THIS SMOKE EXISTS FOR: the PER-NODE SUPPLIED COUNTS. The GEPA store grows the Planner slice from CELL-1's 14 values to 77 and holds the Reviewer slice at 92, so these four registered rows -- which carry audio_volume_*, play_* and iot_hue_* candidates -- now reach three of the four routes at or near cap where CELL-2's retained 200-value store reached almost none of them. The offline four-row dry run over the RELEASED GEPA stores (scripts/flights/batch/gepacell_dry_run.py, zero contacts) therefore predicts, per row in roster order, Solver 8 / 1 / 5 / 0, Reviewer 4 / 4 / 4 / 0 and Planner 4 / 4 / 4 / 0 on the arm and Solver 8 / 4 / 5 / 0, Reviewer 4 / 3 / 4 / 0 and Planner 4 / 2 / 2 / 0 on the twin, with the Perception route SEEDED before the walk (4 unconditional values, the same four value ids as CELL-1's and CELL-2's) rather than supplied at a node boundary. The registered structural rule is that the REALISED counts equal those; a mismatch is a FORM defect that stops the arm. Row slurp:train:000023:audio-1490956038 declines all three candidate-bound routes on both forms -- its iot_hue_lightdim / lighton / lightoff candidates reach no value in the store -- and each declined route is receipted with its reason, reported and not failed. A REVISE revisit acquires a SECOND, DISJOINT slice at this store size (arm Solver 1 / Reviewer 4 / Planner 4 on the second visit, 25 distinct value ids over the episode, zero duplicate acquisitions) instead of acquiring nothing as it did at CELL-2's smaller store; the registered invariant is DISJOINTNESS, because QueryState refuses a duplicate retrieved_value_id and a re-acquisition would kill the trajectory. THE ARM AND THE TWIN ARE NOT EXPECTED TO MATCH per node: the derangement moves each row's whole attachment tuple, so a candidate-bound route selects a different slice and only the store's total authored token count (7,345) is held. Whether the candidate-bound routes serve AT ALL over the population is answered on the 1,080-row arm by its own delta-consumption table (the B9a-rec inert-route check at population level), never by these four rows. STRUCTURAL ONLY: no official score is run here and no effectiveness claim is read from it. Run and attempt identities are new because CELL-1's and CELL-2's smoke identities are consumed and a plan budget is run-cumulative per run id.

stage3_algorithm.note: The four-row form proof of CELL-1-GEPA: the same released GEPA delta store, the same per-node application and the same derangement control as the arms, flown on four rows for structural evidence only. CELL-1-GEPA applies GEPA's released context as ONE factor on the locked plan. The store it pins was produced by GEPA's own two operators: the proposer cell reflected on the sealed ROLL-1 trajectories per (scenario, node) and rewrote that node's guidance text (UPDATE), and the surviving iteration-1 rows were chosen against each scenario's own null band rather than by a pooled average (SELECTION). The per-node context_supply route that puts those statements into a row is the CONTEXT_APPLICATION step, declared here: by the coordinator ruling of 2026-09-24 the registry record gepa-reflective-pareto-v1 defines context_application as well, so every family that applies a released store by candidate-bound supply carries the same application operator.
